create_InferenceSettings: create an InferenceSettings dataclass with tf32, activation checkpointing, merge mole, and compile flags for MLIP inference
create_MLIPInferenceCheckpoint: create an MLIPInferenceCheckpoint dataclass to hold model config, state dict, ema state dict, and tasks config
use_inference_settings_default: use the inference_settings_default function to get default InferenceSettings for most systems and models
use_inference_settings_turbo: use the inference_settings_turbo function to get optimized InferenceSettings for long simulations with constant composition
use_guess_inference_settings: use guess_inference_settings to resolve a string name like turbo or default into an InferenceSettings object
